features: Real-time location tracking: Enjoy peace of mind with real-time location tracking powered by built-in GPS and AGPS technology
2-way video calling: Stay connected to your child through high-quality video calls, thanks to a 2 MP front camera
2-way voice calling supported by all major Indian network providers: Connect with ease through two-way voice calls, supported by India's leading carriers across 4G/3G/2G networks
Safe Zone alerts: Get immediate notifications when your child steps outside their defined safe area, thanks to our geo-fencing feature
School Mode: Keep distractions at bay during study hours by activating School Mode, which restricts all non-essential smartwatch functions
Habit formation reminders: Encourage positive habits and nurture your child's development with habit-forming reminders
Noise Amigo App: Our parent-focused app offers an intuitive interface and vital safety features. Set Safe Zones, block unknown calls, monitor messages and calls, access the camera remotely and more
SOS: In case of emergencies, your child can activate the SOS feature by pressing and holding the button on their watch, instantly sharing their location with you
3-day battery life with 680 mAh: A 3-day battery with 680 mAh makes sure your child’s smartwatch matches their energy
2 MP front camera, stores up to 50 photos: A 2 MP camera with storage of up to 50 images lets your child unlock their inner photographer
